description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Enum, which is used for validating keywords against a list of enumerated valid values within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for constructing, validating, and creating enum instances based on string input.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Enum
classes.description: A class for handling enumeration validation of attribute values according to W3C specifications within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the enum with a list of valid values and case sensitivity setting.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a given string against the enumeration of valid values, considering case sensitivity.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates a new HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Enum instance from a comma-separated string, optionally indicating case sensitivity.
